FOCIL is about to have the first EL interop soon! We will continue to have FOCIL breakout biweekly to keep our momentum.

### Implementation Updates

* **Reth** has been working on interop with Geth and has been resolving a situation that some blocks are being reorged because of missing ILs.
* **Lighthouse** has fixed a bug to fetch ILs submitted in previous slot correctly.
* **Lodestar** is on Fulu and has implemented Beacon metrics.

### Testing

Once we have working multi-client devnet, we could use some CLI flag to produce invalid or equivocating ILs for testing purpose.

### FOCIL Metrics

* [Katya](https://x.com/Sib_Katya) has shared [FOCIL beacon metrics PR](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/16) and has implemented it in Lodestar.
* [Katya](https://x.com/Sib_Katya) and [Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab) would work on Execution Metrics afterward.

### Links
- [FOCIL beacon metrics PR](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/16)
- [Reth Prototype](https://github.com/PelleKrab/reth/tree/focil_impl)
